selection: largest and smallest admitted development pools by row count, ties task_id; not outcome-based
initial_selection: uniform without replacement using fixed seed; no known-hit condition
predictor: preserved Tanimoto logistic Bernoulli GP Laplace adapter
model_weights: equal before forecast observations; known observations already incorporated by predictor
forecast_update: Bernoulli reweighting of fixed posterior function particles; a proxy for future GP refitting
reference_control: nominal mixture paired rollout with shared baseline/state caches
revision_1: pointwise minimum across model expected paired rollout gains; Monte Carlo point estimates only
revision_2: fixed-stage simultaneous Hoeffding paired-gain bounds and robust confidence screening with compute interruption
candidate_order: declared predictive mean plus variance ranking; includes common Greedy; not global-action optimality
claims: adapter/calibration/scaling/reduction evidence only; no molecular policy benefit or independent novelty certificate
